title: Train on prefill, monitor at decode: Using sparse autoencoders for topic monitoring
description:
arXiv:2611.12935v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Topic monitoring is the task of labelling the topic of each token in a model's response during generation. Activation-based monitors that run at generation time have so far been trained to detect harmful content and are limited to two or three classes.
